sentences.text:
Author: Deepak Verma
Bench: Deepak Verma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 78
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 5180 of 2023
Applicant :- Mohammad Anis

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Santosh Kumar Tiwari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
Heard Sri Santosh Kumar Tiwari, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ram Adhar Ram, learned
A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The instant bail application has been filed with a prayer to release the applicant on bail in Case
Crime No. 175 of 2021, registered under Sections 3/7 of the Essential Commodities Act and Sections
419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 409, 120-B I.P.C., Police Station Chhawni, District Basti during pendency of
the trial.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive.
Allegation against the applicant is false and fabricated.
Applicant has no concern with the allegation in the FIR.
With malice intention, present FIR has been lodged.
Applicant applied for anticipatory bail before the Sessions Judge and Sessions Judge vide order dated 27.07.2021 granted anticipatory bail.

Applicant has not misused the Mohammad Anis vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185170789/
1 anticipatory bail granted to him.

entities.text: Mohammad Anis vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Applicant is not a license holder of the shop.
Allegation regarding shortage in stock of Wheat 50.51 kg, Rice 21.75 quintal and Sugar 36 kg is without any evidence.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 04.01.2023.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer of the applicant.

Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and the law laid down by the Apex Court in Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant, Mohammad Anis, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
1. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
2. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
3. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 21.2.2023 Nitin Verma  Mohammad Anis vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185170789/
